document.title: RangeClamp プログラム仕様書
document.status_label: 試作仕様 要件確認前
document.author: Codex作成 人による承認前

overview.purpose: Return an integer clamped to inclusive lower and upper bounds.
overview.scope: One stateless C90 function with three int arguments and an int return value.
overview.source_requirement: Return lower when value < lower, upper when value > upper, otherwise value. The caller guarantees lower <= upper.
overview.source_locator: RangeClamp minimal code example in routine-code-c90 assets/examples/range-clamp/spec.json; supplied example, not a formal external requirement.
overview.coverage: Covers the inclusive clamp only. No errors, state or platform API are defined.

interface.visibility: Ordinary C function declaration in a header.
interface.prototype: int RangeClamp(int value, int lower, int upper);

parameters.name: value
parameters.contract: Value to clamp; any representable int.

return_codes.meaning: lower if value < lower; upper if value > upper; otherwise value. No error return codes are defined.

interface.preconditions: lower <= upper. All arguments may be any representable int consistent with that ordering.

result_fields.name: return
result_fields.meaning: An int in [lower, upper]; equal to value when already in range.

steps.text: Otherwise, if value > upper, return upper.

behavior.postconditions: The return value is within the inclusive bounds. No state, memory or external resource is changed.
behavior.timing_semantics: A single call evaluates a bounded number of comparisons. No loop, recursion or measured RTOS timing is specified.

constraints.text: The caller supplies lower <= upper. Behavior outside this precondition is not specified.
Use C90. Do not call external APIs, allocate memory, loop or recurse.
Compare values directly. Do not subtract bounds or introduce arithmetic overflow.
